kpmae02.title: Four months of maybe
kpmae02.caption:
Four months of hanging out and nobody has said what it is.
Going slow is fine. Say what you want in one honest sentence, at your own pace. Save this for the talk you keep putting off.

kpmae03.title: Fourteen drafts, one send
kpmae03.caption:
Fourteen drafts of hello. Mars deleted thirteen of them.
The one that got sent was about noodles. How many drafts deep is your Gemini right now?

kpmae04.title: You can go first
kpmae04.caption:
Waiting for them to make the first move so it can't hurt.
Going first is allowed. A no is information, not a verdict on you. Try it gently: I'd love to see you again, no pressure.

kpmae05.title: The 40-step ask
kpmae05.caption:
Leo planned a choir, a balloon arch and a 14-minute slideshow to ask one question.
Mars edited it down to three words. Pisces still showed up as the choir. Tag the Leo with a plan.

kpmae06.title: The spreadsheet can't ask
kpmae06.caption:
Three weeks of rows and columns about one person, and the total still says error.
You'll never have all the data. Ask one small, clear question and let their answer be the data.

kpmae07.title: Your eyes already voted
kpmae07.caption:
Libra ran a whole poll on who to talk to at the party.
Mars had one question: who do you keep looking at? The window person, every single time. Comment your Libra's poll results.
